name: Erwin Paternotte
biography: Erwin works as a lead security consultant at Nixu Benelux. He has 15 years experience conducting penetration tests and security assessments on a wide variety of systems and technology. In the recent years his focus is shifting towards more advanced tests like red teaming, embedded systems, ICS/SCADA, and telco systems. Within Nixu he is also the practice lead for penetration and security testing.
